rules.sentence: Medial epicondylitis	Activities involving repetitive valgus stress and flexion, tenderness just distal to the medial epicondyle	Common flexor tendon
Ulnar neuropathy	Numbness and tingling in the ulnar side forearm/hand as well as the fourth and fifth fingers	Ulnar nerve and cubital tunnel
Cubital tunnel syndrome	Same as above	Cause of entrapment
Ulnar nerve instability	+Medial snapping during flexion	Dynamic instability
Snapping triceps syndrome	+Medial double snapping during flexion	Triceps medial head
Ulnar collateral ligament injury	Overhead throwers, valgus instability	Ulnar collateral ligament
Medial antebrachial cutaneous neuropathy	Often associated with distal biceps tendon tear, iatrogenic injury	Medial antebrachial cutaneous nerves
Arthritis	Clinical history of overuse, trauma, inflammatory arthritis, or gout	Elbow joint
